subject: general
question:
_______ orbit did not have a space station.

A. Mir

B. Salyut 7

C. Skylab

D. Voyager 1
solution:
The correct answer is __**Voyager 1**__.

__
 
• **Voyager 1 is a space probe that was launched by NASA on September 5, 1977.**

 
 
• Real-time distance and velocity data are provided by NASA and JPL. At a distance of 152.2 AU (22.8 billion km; 14.1 billion mi) from Earth as of January 12, 2020, it is the most distant human-made object from Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
 
 
• Voyager 1 is the first human-made object to venture into interstellar space.
 
 
• Voyager 1 discovered a thin ring around Jupiter and two new Jovian moons: Thebe and Metis.
 
• At **Saturn, Voyager 1 found five new moons and a new ring called the G-ring.**
 
• Voyager 1 and Voyager 2 are still functioning today, making them the longest-running and most-distant space mission in history.
 
• Though they are each taking different paths, both spacecraft are still screaming their way out of the solar system.
